value.text: {"claims": [{"quote": "Three of five independently said that since roughly Sept 22 their commercial-intent queries (\"best X\", \"X vs Y\", \"buy X near me\") are showing an expanded AI answer unit above the ads on a much larger share of searches than in August.", "tickers": ["GOOGL"], "entities": [], "kind": "channel_check", "metric": "share of commercial-intent searches showing expanded AI answer unit above ads", "period": null, "value": null, "unit": null, "direction": "up", "first_hand": true}, {"quote": "All three reported paid click volume on those query groups down 9-12% vs. the prior four weeks at flat bids.", "tickers": ["GOOGL"], "entities": [], "kind": "channel_check", "metric": "paid click volume on commercial-intent query groups", "period": null, "value": null, "unit": null, "direction": "down", "first_hand": true}, {"quote": "Offsetting this, CPCs on the affected groups are up 6-8% as advertisers bid more for the remaining slots.", "tickers": ["GOOGL"], "entities": [], "kind": "channel_check", "metric": "CPCs on affected query groups", "period": null, "value": null, "unit": null, "direction": "up", "first_hand": true}, {"quote": "Two agencies said they have moved 5-8% of budget on those groups to Performance Max and shopping placements, where volume looks stable.", "tickers": ["GOOGL"], "entities": [], "kind": "channel_check", "metric": "budget moved to Performance Max and shopping placements", "period": null, "value": null, "unit": null, "direction": null, "first_hand": true}, {"quote": "Street models we have seen assume stable paid click growth of low-to-mid single digits for Q4.", "tickers": ["GOOGL"], "entities": [], "kind": "opinion", "metric": "paid click growth assumed in Street models", "period": "Q4", "value": null, "unit": null, "direction": null, "first_hand": false}]}
